scope: Synthetic FinTrace three-source scoring demonstration; no real customer data

columns.payment_id: Required unique payment identifier within dataset
columns.payment_date: ISO date used for the effective-policy join
columns.payment_currency: ISO currency code; monetary joins must match currency
columns.payment_amount: Decimal string; cast DECIMAL(18,2) for arithmetic
columns.settlement_status: ERP reported status, distinct from bank observation

columns.payment_reference: Required ERP reference join key; unique per currency only in this sample
columns.amount: Positive decimal string; direction is separate
columns.status: posted or returned; returned does not count as posted settlement

columns.currency: ISO currency code for threshold amounts
columns.variance_review_threshold: Decimal string; 25.00 demonstration threshold, not evidence that a difference is a fee

quality_expectations: Required identifiers must be present and unique at their declared grain.
Bank payment_reference and currency must be present for a safe join.
Keep absent bank rows NULL; do not silently substitute amount zero.
Avoid overlapping effective policies and aggregate one-to-many bank feeds before joining.
Include currency in monetary joins and aggregation groups.
publication_caveat: Three separately connected simulated business feeds, not three independent real enterprise systems. Bank and ERP mock records share a scenario generator.
